Product Strategy & Vision

Homeownership is often viewed through a singular lens: securing a primary residence. However, a significant market gap exists for entry-level investors who fail to recognise the ROI potential of room-lets or multi-unit properties. Without accessible, high-fidelity financial tools, these users often suffer from "analysis paralysis" or make sub-optimal investment choices based on incomplete data.

The Product Goal: To develop a centralised, data-driven financial ecosystem that demystifies property investment. By consolidating fragmented calculators into a single intuitive web app, we empower users to transition from passive observers to informed investors.

Discovery & Stakeholder Alignment: I spearheaded the initial discovery phase, conducting stakeholder interviews and focus groups to align business objectives with user pain points.

  • User Research: Leveraged qualitative interviews with first-time buyers and landlords to identify core "jobs-to-be-done."
  • Persona Architecture: Developed robust user personas to segment the market into "Accidental Landlords," "Strategic Investors," and "Financial Advisors."
  • Requirement Scoping: Managed the product backlog, identifying "Must-Have" features such as location-based ROI analysis and comparative property benchmarking.

Market Research & Competitive Intelligence

To ensure product-market fit, I conducted a deep-dive competitive audit:

  • Financial Modelling: Analysed existing investment formulas (Gross vs Net Yield, LTV, and Stress Testing) to ensure the app’s backend logic was industry-standard and reliable.
  • Benchmarking: Evaluated top-tier financial apps to identify UX friction points in their calculation flows, specifically targeting complex data entry.
  • Trend Analysis: Prioritised a "Data Visualisation First" approach to make dense financial output digestible at a glance.

Outcome: I defined a strategic product roadmap that prioritised ease-of-use as our primary competitive advantage.

UX Architecture & User Journey

As the lead UX strategist, I focused on reducing the "interaction cost" of complex financial inputs.

The Iterative Process:

  1. Low-Fidelity Wireframing: Built structural blueprints to validate the information architecture and navigation flow.
  2. Interactive Prototyping: Developed click-through models to test the transition between input fields and results dashboards.
  3. Usability Testing: Facilitated "Think-Aloud" sessions with target users. This led to a pivotal redesign of the input sliders, which users found more intuitive than manual typing for hypothetical "What-If" scenarios.

Product Management & Delivery

I owned the end-to-end product lifecycle, acting as the bridge between design vision and technical execution.

Strategic Impact:

  • Roadmap Management: Established clear milestones and KPIs to track project velocity and success metrics.
  • Value-Based Prioritisation: Applied MoSCoW and Kano models to the feature backlog. I specifically advocated for the "Property Comparison" tool as a high-value differentiator for the MVP (Minimum Viable Product).
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Syncing daily with developers and designers to resolve technical blockers and ensure the final build remained true to the UX specifications.

UI Design & Brand Evolution

The interface design was an exercise in balancing aesthetic appeal with functional clarity.

  1. V1 Hypothesis: Initially utilised a high-contrast gradient theme to create a modern, "FinTech" feel.

  2. The Pivot: Usability testing indicated that gradients caused visual "vibration" and hindered readability during data-heavy tasks. I pivoted to:

    • Minimalist Visual Language: Swapped gradients for solid brand tones to improve accessibility.
    • Optimised Hierarchy: Redesigned the results card to highlight "Net Monthly Profit" as the primary anchor point.
    • Contextual Spacing: Increased whitespace to prevent user overwhelm on desktop viewports.

The Final Solution

The final product is a conversion-optimised financial engine that transforms complex investment data into actionable insights. It serves as a single source of truth for property analysis.

Product Highlights:

  • Smart ROI Engine: Calculates real-time yield and capital growth based on user variables and historical trends.
  • Side-by-Side Benchmarking: A modular comparison view allowing users to evaluate up to three investment scenarios simultaneously.
  • Universal Responsiveness: A bespoke layout that maintains high-fidelity interaction design on both mobile and widescreen desktop displays.

Impact & Growth Insights

  • Informed Decision Making: Post-launch surveys indicated users felt 40% more confident in their investment valuations compared to using traditional spreadsheets.
  • Strategic PM Learning: Managing this project reinforced the importance of the "Pivot": recognising when a design choice (like the initial gradients) conflicts with the core user goal and having the agility to course-correct.
  • Design-Dev Synergy: By maintaining a clean component library, we ensured the development phase was 20% faster than previous internal benchmarks, highlighting the value of a PM with deep UX/Dev literacy.

Product Metrics & Success Tracking

To transition from "Project Completion" to "Product Growth," I defined a framework to measure the long-term impact and ROI of the Property Calculator. As a Product Manager, I prioritise data-driven iterations over subjective enhancements.

  • Engagement (North Star Metric): Average number of "Calculation Sessions" per user. A high frequency indicates the tool is being used for iterative "What-If" scenarios during the property research phase.
  • Conversion Rate (CR): The percentage of users who, after running a calculation, click through to "Save Report" or "Consult an Advisor." This measures the tool's effectiveness as a lead-generation engine.
  • Retention Rate: Monitoring how many users return to the app over a 30, 60, and 90-day period. This helps identify the lifecycle of a typical property search.
  • Task Completion Time: Measuring the time taken from the first input to the final ROI result. A decrease in this metric following UI updates validates my "Reduced Interaction Cost" strategy.
  • SEO & Acquisition: Tracking organic search rankings for the primary keywords identified in the research phase (e.g., "Buy-to-let ROI calculator UK") to measure the success of the content strategy.

Strategic Roadmap: Phase 2

Looking ahead, I have identified three key "Epic" features to drive further user value and business growth:

  1. Live Data Integration: API hooks into real-time market data (e.g., Zoopla or Rightmove) to automatically populate local average rents and house prices based on postcodes.
  2. Tax & Regulatory Module: An advanced toggle for Stamp Duty (SDLT) and Section 24 tax changes to provide a more accurate "Net Profit" figure for professional landlords.
  3. Portfolio Dashboard: Allowing users to save multiple properties and view their total "Portfolio Yield," moving the product from a single-use calculator to a long-term management asset.

Final Reflections

This project was a testament to the synergy between UX Research and Product Management. By starting with a deep understanding of the user’s financial anxieties and ending with a technically robust, scalable solution, I demonstrated that the best products aren't just built—they are strategically grown.

My ability to pivot based on testing (removing the gradients), prioritise features based on business value (Kano/MoSCoW), and architect a dev-ready component library ensures that this product is not only user-centric but also commercially viable and technically sustainable.
